opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that can evidence outstanding quality teaching; institutions only, not individuals.
opportunities.summary: Supports specialist arts institutions to provide training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours, covering tuition, maintenance, equipment, travel, etc.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000; bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities offering undergraduate/postgraduate degrees; universities are not eligible; institutions only.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts, covering tuition, maintenance, and other costs.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 salary contribution in year 1, up to £28,000 in years 2‑3; research expenses up to £6,000 per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not yet have held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, be UK‑resident, and be employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, providing salary contributions and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers who have a UK university affiliation, live in the UK ≥26 weeks/year, and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Enables retired scholars to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each; each award funds 18 UK‑rate doctoral scholarships and 6 international‑rate scholarships

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides large‑scale doctoral scholarships in interdisciplinary priority research areas, including funding for students, post‑doctoral opportunities, and programme administration.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial for this round) may apply singly or as multi‑institution collaborations.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale research centres to achieve step‑change in scholarship across any discipline.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs (full) plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; cannot have held a previous Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Supports distinguished scholars to complete original research, providing salary support and limited research expenses.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers (doctoral award ≤10 years before deadline) with a permanent post or long‑term fellowship at a UK university; must have international impact.
opportunities.summary: Provides a £100,000 prize to support any research purpose for promising early‑career researchers.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑stage UK university lecturers (or equivalent) with ≤2 years post‑PhD experience, not yet leading a research team, and not having held comparable awards or >£100k project funding.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at UK universities (or eligible UK research institutes on trial) with a UK institution affiliation; must propose innovative, interdisciplinary research.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for original research projects up to five years, covering staff costs, research expenses, and associated costs.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) who will coordinate the visit; host institution must have research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite eminent overseas professors for 3‑12 months to bring novel expertise and enhance skills of staff and students.
